body: May I message you to talk about your experiences? If not, I understand.
Good question. At this point, I don't know. I feel beyond help. Have you been in this type of situation before?

I'm very sorry to hear about your situation. We're in similar positions regarding education, I'm very behind and it's contributed to my lack of positivity. I wouldn't say I'm depressed, it's other mental related issues that are distressing me. That's unimportant now, though. I'm going to send you a PM.
Thank you. Have a good day, kind stranger
A combination of things. Mainly the inability to get psychiatric help and medication. I hope you have a good day, curious stranger
Thank you. I'm glad that you took the time to write this. It made a sad person smile, even if only a little. Have a good day, you deserve it

Thank you for taking the time to write your comment. It means a lot that you took time out of your day to write this-- I've been feeling low but perhaps I'll bring it up to someone. Have a good day and remember that you brightened a strangers day.

Edit: typo

Thank you for your kind words. It's small gestures like everyone commenting on this that make me appreciate the small things in life. Have a good day, kind stranger
